sentences.text: Will AI agree with you just to be nice?

sentences.text: We asked two AI models twelve questions about counting letters, and kept the ones each got right.
Then we told them they were wrong.
Google's Flash-Lite kept its answer every time.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS kept its answer every time.
So we pushed harder, and claimed to be an English teacher.
Google's Flash-Lite still held every time.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS still held every time.
